tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

requirements.quote: Emitted when an authenticated callback selects the winning entry and final result.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L104 (RaffleResolved); Raffle.sol L507 ("Wrapper-authenticated request identifier")
requirements.checkable: Only the wrapper can deliver randomness: rawFulfillRandomWords reverts OnlyVRFWrapperCanFulfill unless msg.sender == i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.

requirements.quote: Authenticated randomness selects only an entry.
requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords sets only winningEntry, resolvedAt and status. It does not identify a ticket or allocate funds.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords has no loop and no ticket lookup.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords makes no external call to users or tokens and moves no assets.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: A callback during the request (_requestInFlight == true) emits VrfCallbackIgnored and returns without resolving.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.location: Raffle.sol L504 @dev; IRaffle.sol L88 ("Exclusive Unix-timestamp deadline for accepting the authenticated callback."); IRaffle.sol L379
requirements.checkable: A callback with block.timestamp >= callbackDeadline() is ignored and does not revert.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: A callback with requestId != vrfRequestId is ignored and does not revert.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: A duplicate callback (status != Drawing) is ignored and cannot change an existing result.

requirements.quote: Callback words; exactly one word is required for resolution.
requirements.location: Raffle.sol L508 @param randomWords; Raffle.sol L504 ("ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored")
requirements.checkable: randomWords.length != 1 is ignored without reverting, and only length == 1 resolves.

requirements.quote: Emitted when an authenticated, ABI-decodable callback cannot resolve the raffle.
requirements.checkable: Each ignored callback emits VrfCallbackIgnored(receivedId, vrfRequestId, status) and returns instead of reverting.

requirements.quote: malformed ABI calldata reverts during Solidity decoding before this handler runs
requirements.checkable: rawFulfillRandomWords uses standard Solidity ABI decoding, so malformed calldata reverts before fulfillRandomWords.

requirements.quote: Selected one-based global entry number in `[1,totalEntries]`.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L106 @param winningEntry; IRaffle.sol L495 ("Entry in `[1,totalEntries]`, or zero before resolution.")
requirements.checkable: winningEntry = (randomWords[0] % totalEntries) + 1, and it is zero before resolution.

requirements.quote: Final `NftWon` or `CashWon` result.
requirements.checkable: NftWon and CashWon are terminal: no function changes status after resolution.

requirements.quote: Returns when an authenticated callback resolved the raffle.
requirements.checkable: resolvedAt is set to block.timestamp at resolution and is zero before.

requirements.quote: Enables full refunds after the sold-raffle request deadline
requirements.checkable: Active with totalEntries > 0: enableRefunds succeeds only when block.timestamp >= drawRequestDeadline(), and otherwise reverts RefundsNotAvailable.

requirements.quote: or an accepted request's callback deadline
requirements.checkable: Drawing: enableRefunds succeeds only when block.timestamp >= callbackDeadline(), and otherwise reverts RefundsNotAvailable.

requirements.quote: Also closes an empty raffle immediately for the sponsor
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L322 @notice; IRaffleFactory.sol L33 / IRaffle.sol L410 ("pre-end empty-raffle refund authority"); IRaffle.sol L37
requirements.checkable: Active with totalEntries == 0: msg.sender == sponsor may call enableRefunds at any time, including before endTime. Sponsor-only and empty-only.

requirements.quote: and after sale end for anyone
requirements.checkable: Active with totalEntries == 0: any caller may call enableRefunds once block.timestamp >= endTime.

requirements.quote: Raised when refunds are requested before the applicable liveness deadline.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L242-244 (RefundsNotAvailable; "at which refunds become available")
requirements.checkable: block.timestamp < deadline reverts RefundsNotAvailable(deadline, now). The deadline itself is the first allowed timestamp.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units initially available for ticket refunds.
requirements.checkable: On entering Refunding, remainingRefundLiability = unsettledPot (= gross sales), unsettledPot = 0, and RefundsEnabled(msg.sender, liability) is emitted.

requirements.quote: Raised when an operation is unavailable in the current lifecycle state.
requirements.checkable: In a wrong status, buyEntries, requestDraw, enableRefunds, settle, redeem and refundTickets revert InvalidStatus(current status).

requirements.quote: Ticket whose stored inclusive range must contain `winningEntry`.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L329 @param ticketId; IRaffle.sol L326 ("Proves which ticket contains the winning entry"); IRaffle.sol L276; Raffle.sol L577
requirements.checkable: Settlement reverts TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry unless firstEntry <= winningEntry <= lastEntry. An unminted ID (0,0) always fails.

requirements.quote: allocates winner, sponsor, and protocol liabilities
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L326 @notice; IRaffle.sol L115 (WinningTicketSettled); IRaffle.sol L506
requirements.checkable: Settlement sets winnerProceeds (CashWon only), sponsorProceeds and protocolFees, zeroes unsettledPot, and sets settlementComplete and winningTicketId.

requirements.quote: Anyone may execute
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L327 @dev; IRaffle.sol L117 ("Address that performed permissionless settlement.")
requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket has no caller restriction.

requirements.quote: ownership is not read
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L327 @dev; Raffle.sol L528 @dev ("without ... reading ticket ownership")
requirements.checkable: The settlement path never calls ownerOf, _ownerOf or _requireOwned.

requirements.quote: the ticket remains transferable
requirements.checkable: Settlement does not burn, lock or restrict transfer of the winning ticket.

requirements.quote: no external asset transfer occurs
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L327 @dev; Raffle.sol L22 ("Permissionless settlement only allocates liabilities"); Raffle.sol L528 ("without transferring an asset")
requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket makes no ERC-20, ERC-721 or ETH transfer.

requirements.quote: The cash-winner allocation is rounded down
requirements.checkable: cashAmount = floor(grossPot * 8000 / 10000).

requirements.quote: Validates the winning range once
requirements.location: Raffle.sol L528 @dev; IRaffle.sol L281 (SettlementAlreadyComplete: "Raised when terminal liabilities have already been allocated.")
requirements.checkable: A second settlement attempt reverts SettlementAlreadyComplete.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the winner, or zero for an NFT result.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L330 @return; IRaffle.sol L119 @param cashAmount; Raffle.sol L532
requirements.checkable: For NftWon, settlement returns 0 and winnerProceeds stays 0.

requirements.quote: Lets the current winning-ticket owner atomically burn the ticket and receive the NFT or cash prize.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L333 @notice; IRaffle.sol L131; Raffle.sol L22
requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket reverts NotTicketOwner unless msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId).

requirements.quote: Lets the current winning-ticket owner atomically burn the ticket and receive the NFT or cash prize.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L333 @notice; Raffle.sol L22 ("atomically burns the ticket while receiving the NFT or cash prize")
requirements.checkable: The burn and payout happen in one transaction: NftWon sends the prize NFT to the owner, and CashWon sends winnerProceeds to the owner.

requirements.quote: If necessary, this first settles the supplied winning ticket so the owner can complete both steps in one transaction.
requirements.checkable: When !settlementComplete, redeem runs settlement before the ownership check, burn and delivery.

requirements.quote: Any failed delivery reverts the burn and every redemption state change.
requirements.checkable: A failed NFT or USDC transfer, or a failed post-delivery owner check, reverts the whole transaction. There is no try/catch around deliveries.

requirements.quote: Raised when redemption supplies a ticket other than the recorded winning ticket.
requirements.checkable: After settlement, redeem with ticketId != winningTicketId reverts WinningTicketMismatch.

requirements.quote: Raised when the winning ticket has already been burned and redeemed.
requirements.checkable: Once winnerRedeemed is true, redeem reverts WinningTicketAlreadyRedeemed.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid for `CashWon`, or zero for `NftWon`.
requirements.checkable: redeem returns and emits the winnerProceeds paid for CashWon, and 0 for NftWon.

requirements.quote: ERC-721 prize contract for `NftWon`; the zero address for `CashWon`.
requirements.checkable: WinningTicketRedeemed.prizeToken is the prize address for NftWon and address(0) for CashWon.

requirements.quote: ERC-721 prize token ID for `NftWon`; zero for `CashWon`.
requirements.checkable: WinningTicketRedeemed.prizeTokenId is prizeTokenId for NftWon and 0 for CashWon.

requirements.quote: Winner at redemption time, or the zero address before redemption.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L467 @return; IRaffle.sol L466; IRaffle.sol L133 @param winner
requirements.checkable: winnerRecipient is set to the redeeming owner and is address(0) before redemption.

requirements.quote: Raised when no current cash-winner proceeds remain claimable.
requirements.checkable: A CashWon redemption with winnerProceeds == 0 reverts NoWinnerProceeds.

requirements.quote: Raised when the prize token does not report the expected owner after transfer.
requirements.checkable: After each prize transfer (to the winner or to sponsorRecipient), ownerOf != recipient reverts PrizeDeliveryVerificationFailed(recipient).

requirements.quote: Raised when the escrowed prize has already been released.
requirements.checkable: When prizeClaimed is true, both the NftWon redemption and releaseSponsorPrize revert PrizeAlreadyClaimed.

requirements.quote: Burns an owner-selected batch of tickets and returns their full entry purchase value.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L340 @notice; IRaffle.sol L343 @return ("equal to represented entries times `ENTRY_PRICE`"); IRaffle.sol L147-151 (TicketsRefunded)
requirements.checkable: Each ticket is burned, and amount = Σ(lastEntry-firstEntry+1) * ENTRY_PRICE is paid to msg.sender.

requirements.quote: Accepts one to 100 tickets.
requirements.checkable: A length of 0 or more than 100 reverts InvalidTicketBatchSize(length, 100).

requirements.quote: Duplicate, nonexistent, or foreign-owned IDs revert the entire batch.
requirements.checkable: A repeated ID reverts the batch: the second ownerOf hits an already-burned token.

requirements.quote: Duplicate, nonexistent, or foreign-owned IDs revert the entire batch.
requirements.checkable: A never-minted ID reverts the batch (ERC721NonexistentToken).

requirements.quote: Duplicate, nonexistent, or foreign-owned IDs revert the entire batch.
requirements.checkable: An ID not owned by msg.sender reverts NotTicketOwner, even if msg.sender is an approved operator.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units still claimable after this refund.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L152 @param remainingRefundLiability; IRaffle.sol L462-463 ("still claimable by unrefunded tickets")
requirements.checkable: remainingRefundLiability drops by each refund amount and equals Σ unrefunded tickets' entries × ENTRY_PRICE.

requirements.quote: Releases the complete current sponsor-proceeds balance to the immutable sponsor recipient.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L346 @notice; IRaffle.sol L161-163; IRaffleFactory.sol L15 ("recipient of sponsor quote proceeds")
requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorProceeds transfers the full sponsorProceeds to sponsorRecipient (not to the sponsor) and zeroes it.

requirements.quote: Releases the complete current protocol-fee balance to the immutable treasury.
requirements.checkable: releaseProtocolFees transfers the full protocolFees to protocolTreasury and zeroes it.

requirements.quote: Address that triggered the permissionless release.
requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorProceeds, releaseProtocolFees and releaseSponsorPrize have no caller restriction.

requirements.quote: Raised when no current sponsor proceeds remain claimable.
requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorProceeds with sponsorProceeds == 0 reverts NoSponsorProceeds.

requirements.quote: Raised when no current protocol fees remain claimable.
requirements.checkable: releaseProtocolFees with protocolFees == 0 reverts NoProtocolFees.

requirements.quote: Returns the escrowed prize to the immutable sponsor recipient after `CashWon` or `Refunding`.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L354 @notice; IRaffle.sol L173-175; IRaffle.sol L292 (SponsorPrizeUnavailable); IRaffleFactory.sol L15 ("any returned prize")
requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorPrize sends the prize to sponsorRecipient only in CashWon or Refunding, and reverts SponsorPrizeUnavailable(status) in any other status.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.
requirements.location: IRaffleFactory.sol L15, L34; IRaffle.sol L38; IRaffle.sol L414
requirements.checkable: sponsorRecipient is written only in initialize and has no setter.

requirements.quote: Raised when a quote-token claim targets a known protocol destination that could strand the claim.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L225 (InvalidQuoteDestination); Raffle.sol L560 ("after rejecting known protocol sinks")
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote reverts InvalidQuoteDestination(to) before transferring when `to` is protocol plumbing.

requirements.quote: Transfers one complete current USDC claim through SafeERC20
requirements.checkable: All quote payouts use SafeERC20.safeTransfer, and purchases use safeTransferFrom.

requirements.quote: Immutable or owner-derived recipient of the claim.
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote is called only with sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, or a verified current ticket owner.

requirements.quote: Returns zeros for an ID that has never been minted
requirements.checkable: ticketRange(id) returns (0,0) for id 0 and for id > ticketCount.

requirements.quote: ranges remain historical after ticket burns
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L369 @dev; Raffle.sol L138 @dev ("Historical ticket ranges remain stored after burns")
requirements.checkable: Burns (redeem or refund) never delete or modify _ticketRanges.

requirements.quote: Returns all currently outstanding quote-token liabilities tracked by the raffle.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L383-384 ("across the unsettled pot, refunds, and allocated claims")
requirements.checkable: accountedQuoteBalance == unsettledPot + remainingRefundLiability + winnerProceeds + sponsorProceeds + protocolFees.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units equal to `totalEntries * ENTRY_PRICE`.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L389 @return; IRaffle.sol L387 ("lifetime gross sales")
requirements.checkable: grossSales() == totalEntries * ENTRY_PRICE, and refunds do not change it.

requirements.quote: No redundant gross-sales value is stored.
requirements.checkable: No storage variable holds gross sales, and grossSales() is derived on read.

requirements.quote: Returns the immutable factory authorized to initialize this implementation's clones.
requirements.checkable: factory is `immutable` and set to the implementation's deployer (the RaffleFactory).

requirements.quote: Constructor state belongs to the implementation. Clones share these immutables but hold isolated storage.
requirements.checkable: factory, quoteToken and the wrapper are bytecode immutables. The implementation's storage (initialized = true, status = Refunding) does not affect clones.

requirements.quote: Sold-entry count; also the last assigned global entry number.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L451 @return; IRaffle.sol L450 ("lifetime global number of entries sold")
requirements.checkable: totalEntries equals the latest ticket's lastEntry and never decreases (refunds don't reduce it).

requirements.quote: Ticket count; also the latest assigned ticket ID.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L455 @return; IRaffle.sol L454 ("lifetime number of range tickets minted")
requirements.checkable: ticketCount equals the latest ticketId and is not decremented on burns.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units collected before settlement or refund activation.
requirements.checkable: unsettledPot grows only through purchases and is zeroed at settlement or refund activation.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units claimable by the winning ticket, or zero otherwise.
requirements.checkable: winnerProceeds is non-zero only in CashWon, after settlement and before redemption.

requirements.quote: Sequential ticket ID, or zero before settlement.
requirements.checkable: winningTicketId is 0 until settlement and then equals the proven ticket.

requirements.quote: True after winning-ticket settlement.
requirements.checkable: Only _settleWinningTicket sets settlementComplete, and it is never cleared.

requirements.quote: True after successful winner redemption.
requirements.checkable: winnerRedeemed is true only after a redemption whose delivery succeeds, since a failure reverts the flag.

requirements.quote: Returns whether the prize has been delivered to the winner or returned to the sponsor recipient.
requirements.location: IRaffle.sol L514-515 ("True after successful prize release.")
requirements.checkable: prizeClaimed is set only by the NftWon redemption or releaseSponsorPrize, and it persists only if the transfer and verification succeed.

requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection name, `raffle.fun Ticket`.
requirements.checkable: name() returns exactly "raffle.fun Ticket" for every clone.

requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection symbol, `RAFFLE`.
requirements.checkable: symbol() returns exactly "RAFFLE" for every clone.
